reviewMethod: Independently read all 126 retained complete EN/ZH pairs, selected POS and Chinese meanings, and all corresponding frozen term/POS/Chinese definitions/variants/evidence definitions in three non-truncated show-review-pack segments (rows 1–42, 43–84, 85–126). Then read every corresponding frozen rank and evidence id/lexfile/matchedLemma/match field. Checked English naturalness, Chinese fidelity, actual head use, sense/POS, name labels and technical/old-register meanings. Primary-source checks resolved alditol terminology and the coral-polyp concern: IUPAC Gold Book A00210, Nanjing University chemistry authors' alditol research page, original Chinese patent CN116747217B paragraph 0079 and CN108135814B paragraph 0066 (醛醇(alditol)/糖醇), and NOAA Coral Basics/coral polyp anatomy. No blocking defect remains known. This reviewer did not author or alter any p046 pair or its lock; exact current pack source hash independently recomputed before decision.
